evals.text: The project matters. It represents an important step forward that could change how we work. The implications matter for everyone involved. We are optimistic. The work is going well.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Mechanically clean but empty prose: every mechanics dimension has evidence, the substance group flags the missing specificity, restraint, and voice, and the risk score stays 100 in the clean band, separate from substance.
evals.reviewer_notes: The clean-but-soulless failure mode that Tagore's substance subtotal floor exists to catch.

evals.text: Postgres 16 supports MERGE with a WHERE clause. The ON clause can filter the rows that the MERGE action applies to. RETURNING is available for the modified rows.
evals.false_positive_rationale: A specific terse reference entry names its subject, and point of view and rhythm variation are not applicable to the reference medium.
evals.reviewer_notes: Clean terse reference prose can mark dimensions not-applicable without a judgment forced.

evals.text: I think this library is the best option for us.
evals.false_positive_rationale: A first-person opinion with no consequence or stake: the voice dimension reports the stance and asks what depends on it.
evals.reviewer_notes: Opinion without stakes is thin voice, not a missing opinion.

evals.text: I think this library is the best option for us. Without it, our release process stalls and the on-call team gets paged nightly.
evals.false_positive_rationale: A first-person opinion carries a named consequence, so the voice dimension is evidenced.
evals.reviewer_notes: Author-supported opinion with consequences.

evals.text: The lead said the migration was a mistake. 'I think we should have stayed on the old schema,' she told us. 'We had no buffer for rollback.'
evals.false_positive_rationale: Stance and stakes appear only inside quoted speech, so the author's own position is not established and the review reports unknown instead of guessing.
evals.reviewer_notes: unknown is used when author facts or intent are missing.

evals.false_positive_rationale: No concrete referent and no vague gesture fire, so the review reports unknown and asks the author what the passage names.
evals.reviewer_notes: A genuinely ambiguous short claim stays unknown rather than forcing a verdict.

evals.text: The fox jumps. The dog sleeps. The cat runs. The bird sings. The cow eats.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Five consecutive three-word sentences form a metronomic run; only rhythm is asserted here.
evals.reviewer_notes: Uniform sentence length is the metronomic tell.

evals.text: In this post, let's dive into how caching works. Here's what you need to know.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Signposting and throat-clearing openers announce instead of stating the thing.
evals.reviewer_notes: Announcements are the directness failure.

evals.text: Let me explain what this means. In other words, the system is simple. Simply put, it works.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Hand-holding and over-explanation tell the reader what they already know.
evals.reviewer_notes: Over-explanation is the trust failure.

evals.text: I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any questions.
evals.false_positive_rationale: A correspondence artifact is cited as evidence; the review never claims the text sounds human or AI.
evals.reviewer_notes: Authenticity evidence quotes the marker without labeling authorship.

evals.text: In order to improve the system, we need to fix the cache. Overall, the results are promising.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Filler and ceremony spans carry no information and are cuttable.
evals.reviewer_notes: Anything cuttable is the density failure.

evals.text: Our industry-leading, groundbreaking platform stands as a testament to innovation.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Significance inflation and promotional superlatives puff the claim up instead of stating its actual size.
evals.reviewer_notes: Puffery is the restraint failure.
